description.value: BC Liquor Store is a provincially operated retail chain — one of the largest retailers in British Columbia — offering a broad selection of wine, beer, spirits, ciders, and coolers. This Vancouver Island location on East Island Highway is a convenient stop for touring cyclists looking to resupply with beverages. The store also accepts empty container returns for deposit refunds, a useful service for riders carrying empties.
